about_the_game:
About the Game
Travel back to the 19th century, an era of elegance, invention, and discovery. Explore hand-drawn historic environments—from bustling Victorian streets to peaceful countryside estates—while searching for over 100 mischievous cats hiding in every nook and cranny.

Relax and express your creativity by coloring black-and-white scenes with guided step-by-step palettes or your own freeform pastel colors. The special “Meow FM” radio offers soothing lo-fi and chillhop music to accompany your journey through time.

Play solo for a calming experience or team up with friends in online co-op mode for shared fun. Compete on solo leaderboards and celebrate your achievements in bringing history to life!

Step into a world of nostalgia, charm, and colorful discoveries! 🐾🎨
